scope: Original bounded batch acceptance criteria; no replacement backend, hard native deadline, or production qualification claim.

criteria.requirement: Specify the supported isolation model, read/write conditions, version/ABA behavior and the boundary of transaction atomicity.
Define commit outcomes during cancellation, timeout, process death and failed fsync; clients must reconcile ambiguous outcomes.
Provide documented patterns for idempotency markers, multi-aggregate invariants and bounded conflict retries.
Verify concurrent histories and independent state models, including stale reads, duplicate delivery and failures around every publication boundary.
Retain reviewed design decisions, implementation references, meaningful regression/end-to-end tests, and failure evidence appropriate to this scope.
For performance/data claims, freeze workload/source identities before tuning, compare with an independent oracle, and report actual limits and unsuccessful trials.
Update user-facing documentation and the architecture tracker; do not equate finite passing tests with universal correctness or security.

publication_gates: Final source-hash verification and full regression result
Final-head Linux/macOS Python3.11/3.14 CI success and merged PR
Update original issue and architecture tracker using immutable evidence links
